ben-oni.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H205 (אָוֶן); son of my sorrow;
ben-oni.strongsDef: Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin

geber.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H1397 (גֶּבֶר); son of (the) hero;

dekar.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and a derivative of H1856 (דָּקַר); son of piercing (or of a lance);

begin.kjvDef: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.

obtain.kjvDef: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.

benhadad.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H1908 (הֲדַד); son of Hadad;
benhadad.strongsDef: Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings

ben-zoketh.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2105 (זוֹחֵת); son of Zocheth;

hur.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2354 (חוּר); son of Chur;

ben-hail.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2428 (חַיִל); son of might;

ben-hanan.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2605 (חָנָן); son of Chanan;

hesed.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2617 (חֵסֵד); son of kindness;

bani.strongsDef: Bani, the name of five Israelites

bene-barak.derivation: from the plural construction of H1121 (בֵּן) and H1300 (בָּרָק);
bene-barak.strongsDef: sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine

benaiah.derivation: or בּנָיָהוּ; (prolonged) from H1129 (בָּנָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has built;
benaiah.strongsDef: Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites

bene-jaakan.derivation: from the plural of H1121 (בֵּן) and H3292 (יַעֲקָן); sons of Yaakan;
bene-jaakan.strongsDef: Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert

benjamin.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H3225 (יָמִין); son of (the) right hand;
benjamin.strongsDef: Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory

benjamite.derivation: sometimes (with the article inserted) בֵּן־הַיּמִינִי; with H376 (אִישׁ) inserted (1 Samuel 9:1) בֶּן־אִישׁ ימִינִי; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened אִישׁ יְמִינִי; (1 Samuel 9:4; Esther 2:5) a man of Jemini, or (1 Samuel 20:1) simply יְמִינִיxlit Yᵉmînîy corrected to Yᵉmîynîy; a Jeminite; (plural) בְּנֵי יְמִינִיxlit Bᵉnîy corrected to Bᵉnêy; patron from H1144 (בִּנְיָמִין);
benjamite.strongsDef: a Benjaminite, or descendent of Benjamin

beninu.derivation: probably from H1121 (בֵּן) with pron. suff.; our son;

ben-ammi.derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H5971 (עַם) with pronomial suffix; son of my people;

besodeiah.derivation: from H5475 (סוֹד) and H3050 (יָהּ) with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah;

unripe.derivation: from an unused root meaning to be sour;

grape.derivation: from an unused root meaning to be sour;

ask.kjvDef: ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek.

petition.kjvDef: ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek.

means.strongsDef: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
means.kjvDef: about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within.

inquire.strongsDef: to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask
inquire.kjvDef: cause, inquire, seek up, swell out.

swell.strongsDef: to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask
swell.kjvDef: cause, inquire, seek up, swell out.

beor.derivation: from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of burning); a lamp;
beor.strongsDef: Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam

boaz.derivation: from an unused root of uncertain meaning;
boaz.strongsDef: Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple

dominion.derivation: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1167 (בַּעַל)
dominion.strongsDef: to be master; hence, to marry
dominion.kjvDef: have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, [idiom] wife).

marry.derivation: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1167 (בַּעַל)
marry.strongsDef: to be master; hence, to marry
marry.kjvDef: have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, [idiom] wife).

-ried.derivation: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1167 (בַּעַל)

telem.strongsDef: Telem, the name of a place in Idumaea, also of a temple doorkeeper

talmon.derivation: from the same as H2728 (חָרְגֹּל); oppressive;

unclean.strongsDef: to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated)
unclean.kjvDef: defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, [idiom] utterly.

reputed.strongsDef: to be impure in a religious sense

seduce.strongsDef: to wander; causatively to lead astray

behaviour.strongsDef: properly, a taste, i.e. (figuratively) perception; by implication, intelligence; transitively, a mandate
behaviour.kjvDef: advice, behaviour, decree, discretion, judgment, reason, taste, understanding.

discretion.strongsDef: properly, a taste, i.e. (figuratively) perception; by implication, intelligence; transitively, a mandate
discretion.kjvDef: advice, behaviour, decree, discretion, judgment, reason, taste, understanding.

commanded.strongsDef: properly, a taste, i.e.  ajudicial sentence
commanded.kjvDef: account, [idiom] to be commanded, commandment, matter.

ones.derivation: from H2952 (טָפַף) (perhaps referring to the tripping gait of children);
ones.strongsDef: a family (mostly used collectively in the singular)

families.derivation: from H2952 (טָפַף) (perhaps referring to the tripping gait of children);
families.strongsDef: a family (mostly used collectively in the singular)

coping.strongsDef: a spread of the hand, i.e. a palm-breadth (not 'span' of the fingers); architecturally, a corbel (as a supporting palm)

hand-breadth.strongsDef: a spread of the hand, i.e. a palm-breadth (not 'span' of the fingers); architecturally, a corbel (as a supporting palm)

broad.strongsDef: {a spread of the hand, i.e. a palm-breadth (not 'span' of the fingers); architecturally, a corbel (as a supporting palm)}

forge.strongsDef: properly, to stick on as apatch; figuratively, to impute falsely

sew.strongsDef: properly, to stick on as apatch; figuratively, to impute falsely

nail.derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H6852 (צָפַר), and meaning the same as H6856 (צִפֹּרֶן);
nail.strongsDef: a finger-nail; also a hoof or claw

taphath.derivation: probably from H5197 (נָטַף); a dropping (of ointment);

putrefying.derivation: from an unused root apparently meaning to be moist;
putrefying.strongsDef: properly, dripping; hence, fresh (i.e. recently made such)

ere.derivation: from an unused root apparently meaning to interrupt or suspend;
ere.strongsDef: properly, non-occurrence; used adverbially, not yet or before

ravin.strongsDef: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels)
ravin.kjvDef: catch, [idiom] without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, [idiom] surely, tear (in pieces).

torn.strongsDef: prey, i.e. flocks devoured by animals
torn.kjvDef: ravin, (that which was) torn (of beasts, in pieces).

beasts.strongsDef: prey, i.e. flocks devoured by animals
beasts.kjvDef: ravin, (that which was) torn (of beasts, in pieces).

tarpelites.derivation: (Aramaic) from a name of foreign derivation;
tarpelites.strongsDef: a Tarpelite (collectively) or inhabitants of Tarpel, a place in Assyria

jaazaniah.derivation: or יַאֲזַנְיָהוּ; from H238 (אָזַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); heard of Jah;
jaazaniah.strongsDef: Jaazanjah, the name of four Israelites

jair.strongsDef: Jair, the name of four Israelites

jairite.strongsDef: a Jairite or descendant of Jair

dote.strongsDef: properly, to be slack, i.e. (figuratively) to be foolish

assay.derivation: a primitive root (probably rather the same as H2973 (יָאַל) through the idea of mental weakness);
assay.strongsDef: properly, to yield, especially assent; hence (pos.) to undertake as an act of volition
assay.kjvDef: assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, [idiom] willingly, would.

despair.kjvDef: (cause to) despair, one that is desperate, be no hope.

josiah.derivation: or יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ; from the same root as H803 (אֲשׁוּיָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); founded of Jah;
josiah.strongsDef: Joshijah, the name of two Israelites

jeaterai.derivation: from the same as H871 (אֲתָרִים); stepping;

jebus.strongsDef: Jebus, the original name of Jerusalem

jebusite.strongsDef: a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus

jabin.strongsDef: Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings

ibleam.derivation: from H1104 (בָּלַע) and H5971 (עַם); devouring people;

jabneel.derivation: from H1129 (בָּנָה) and H410 (אֵל); built of God;
jabneel.strongsDef: Jabneel, the name of two places in Palestine

ibneiah.derivation: from H1129 (בָּנָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); built of Jah;

ibnijah.derivation: from H1129 (בָּנָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); building of Jah;

jabbok.strongsDef: Jabbok, a river east of the Jordan

jeberechiah.derivation: from H1288 (בָרַךְ) and H3050 (יָהּ); blessed of Jah;

wither.strongsDef: to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage)
wither.kjvDef: be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame(-fully), [idiom] utterly, wither (away).

jobesh.derivation: the same as H3002 (יָבֵשׁ) (also יָבֵישׁ; often with the addition of H1568 (גִּלְעָד), i.e. Jabesh of Gilad);
jobesh.strongsDef: Jobesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine

-gilead.derivation: the same as H3002 (יָבֵשׁ) (also יָבֵישׁ; often with the addition of H1568 (גִּלְעָד), i.e. Jabesh of Gilad);
-gilead.strongsDef: Jobesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine

jibsam.derivation: from the same as H1314 (בֶּשֶׂם); fragrant;

igal.strongsDef: Jigal, the name of three Israelites

igeal.strongsDef: Jigal, the name of three Israelites

jogbehah.strongsDef: Jogbehah, a place East of the Jordan

igdaliah.derivation: from H1431 (גָּדַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); magnified of Jah;

afflict.kjvDef: afflict, cause grief, grieve, sorrowful, vex.

jegar-sahadutha.derivation: (Aramaic) from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to gather) and a derivation of a root corresponding to H7717 (שָׂהֵד); heap of the testimony;
jegar-sahadutha.strongsDef: Jegar-Sahadutha, a cairn East of the Jordan

appeal.strongsDef: to entitle; by implication, to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.)

easter.strongsDef: the Passover (the meal, the day, the festival or the special sacrifices connected with it)

colosse.strongsDef: Colossæ, a place in Asia Minor

alexandrian.strongsDef: an Alexandreian or inhabitant of Alexandria

alleluiah.derivation: of Hebrew origin (imperative of H01984 and H03050);
alleluiah.strongsDef: praise ye Jah!, an adoring exclamation

cretian.strongsDef: a Cretan, i.e. inhabitant of Crete

perceived.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb;
perceived.strongsDef: to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed)
perceived.kjvDef: allow, be aware (of), feel, (have) know(-ledge), perceived, be resolved, can speak, be sure, understand

resolved.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb;
resolved.strongsDef: to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed)
resolved.kjvDef: allow, be aware (of), feel, (have) know(-ledge), perceived, be resolved, can speak, be sure, understand

myra.strongsDef: Myra, a place in Asia Minor

graff.derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and a derivative of G2759 (κέντρον);

some-.derivation: from the base of G4225 (πού) and G5037 (τέ);
some-.strongsDef: indefinite adverb, at some time, ever
some-.kjvDef: afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n- )ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when

maran-atha.derivation: of Chaldee origin (meaning our Lord has come);
maran-atha.strongsDef: maranatha, i.e. an exclamation of the approaching divine judgment

mint.derivation: neuter of the compound of the same as G2234 (ἡδέως) and G3744 (ὀσμή);

zenas.derivation: probably contracted from a poetic form of G2203 (Ζεύς) and G1435 (δῶρον);

youthful.strongsDef: appertaining to younger persons, i.e. juvenile

two-fold.derivation: from G1364 (δίς) and (probably) the base of G4119 (πλείων);

passed.derivation: including the forms from the alternate ;
passed.strongsDef: (singular) much (in any respect) or (plural) many; neuter (singular) as adverbial, largely; neuter (plural) as adverb or noun often, mostly, largely
passed.kjvDef: abundant, + altogether, common, + far (passed, spent), (+ be of a) great (age, deal, -ly, while), long, many, much, oft(-en (-times)), plenteous, sore, straitly

blastus.derivation: perhaps the same as the base of G985 (βλαστάνω);
blastus.strongsDef: Blastus, an officer of Herod Agrippa

prochorus.strongsDef: before the dance; Prochorus, a Christian

talitha.strongsDef: the fresh, i.e. young girl; talitha (O maiden)

-field.strongsDef: sown, i.e. (neuter plural) a planted field

tithes.strongsDef: to tithe, i.e. to give or take a tenth

castaway.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1384 (δόκιμος);
castaway.strongsDef: unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally)

deliciously.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G4764 (στρῆνος);

torium.strongsDef: the prætorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp)

creation.strongsDef: original formation (properly, the act; by implication, the thing, literally or figuratively)

self-willed.derivation: from G846 (αὐτός) and the base of G2237 (ἡδονή);

trying.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G1382 (δοκιμή);

unutterable.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2980 (λαλέω);

impenitent.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3340 (μετανοέω);

unworthy.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G514 (ἄξιος);
